subject: A newsletter column for Databar tables
body:
Databar's provider list covers firmographics, funding, tech stack, hiring, traffic, reviews and news across 160+ live providers. What it does not carry is the publication itself: no newsletter object, no article to publication attribution, no sponsor to publication pair, no momentum on the list.

That is the category NewsletterFIT adds. A record is a newsletter with its audience and the basis for that figure, the topics it covers, the sponsors running in it, how the list is trending, and the articles each fact came from. An AI pass reads the issues, so what lands in a table is structured fields rather than text a user has to interpret.

For a table builder the shape matters more than the source: I can send a sample export keyed by domain so you can see the join before anyone builds a connector. The same records are queryable over REST and MCP.

If the category is already covered I will take that answer.
